text:
Maria: Heads-up — need quick Q1 hosted capacity sync. Procurement leaning on buy vs lease; finance sims attached. Can we converge by Fri?

Ajay: +1. APAC availability is messy, saw 27% higher peak last month during regional test.

Sophie: Paste of the scenario tool snapshot:
```
Q1 hosted API demand (monthly GPU-hrs):
- baseline: 48,300
- M-o-M growth: +16%
- campaign peak: 72,900
- conservative reserved: 58,000
```
Cost sensitivity (per GPU-hr): buy amortized ~$0.40, lease ~$0.60, on-demand ~$0.98

Kevin: Lead times for H100 racks still ~10-14w. Buying saves ~$0.20/hr but reduces flexibility.

Ajay: Network note — APAC saw three egress blips last 8w. If we add reserved racks there, need robust cross-region fallback (and bandwidth commitment).

Maria: Draft recommendation I'm considering:
1) Buy ~35k GPU-hrs (NA+EU focused)
2) Lease ~20k GPU-hrs to cover APAC uncertainty + Q3 flexibility
3) Keep ~10% on-demand buffer for canaries/failovers

Sophie: If the batching + prefix-cache changes land, we estimate 9-11% reduction in GPU-hrs — could trim lease by ~2-3k.

Ajay: Ops actions: I'll push a routing rule to prefer NA fallback when APAC RTT > 220ms, and cap egress bursts. Expect PR by Wed.

Kevin: I'll spin RFQ for 4 racks and a parallel lease quote. Adding SLAs and delivery penalties. RFQ draft by Tue.

deploy-bot: scale-test/2026-03-10 completed: 2h sustained 80% load, no OOMs, latency within SLOs.

oncall-ops: Current headroom: NA/EU ~20%, APAC ~7% (post-burst projections). Canary capacity marginal.

Maria: Blockers: quantization savings not final (await model-ops sign-off); APAC egress pricing addendum pending.

Sophie: I'll coordinate with model-ops today and update the risk matrix.

Ajay: Also flag: EU-1 cooling capacity might require additional budget if we add racks there.

Maria: Action owner list:
- Kevin: RFQ + lease quotes (due Tue)
- Ajay: fallback routing + egress throttle PR (Wed)
- Sophie: quantization rollout plan + risk matrix (Thu)
- Maria: compile procurement decision draft (Thu)

Kevin: Starting RFQ now. :thumbsup:

Sophie: Syncing with model-ops after this thread.

Maria: I'll add these notes to the capacity playbook and post the procurement links in #eng-infra once available. :rocket:

Ajay: FYI — if we buy more, coordinate with facilities for cooling/PDUs in EU racks.

Maria: Closing thread, will follow up with PR links. Thanks!
